chapter: In The Mood, Rendezvous and Capitol
title: Twenty-three weeks on the charts, American Bandstand and the money
summary: The hit led to Dick Clark's show; the money was split among corporation and players, though appearances paid well.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: Yeah. It stayed on the charts twenty three weeks. That got me on the Dick Clark Show--
Then I did another session for Rod--
Before you go on, did you make pretty good money from In The Mood?
Yes. I didn't get as much as promised to me for In The Mood because it had to be split so many ways, by this corporation, players and everything.
Rene Players, Earl Palmer and you were partners?
